The impact of the crisis will be significant, both in the short and medium run.

3.

The negative repercussions include (i) an expected immediate rise in poverty levels in

affected areas in the absence of social safety nets and given the disruption in existing

community driven development programs; (ii) a deterioration in human capital outcomes,

specifically in health and education, especially if services are not able to resume in a timely

manner; and (iii) a rise in unemployment and under-employment as natural-resource based

local economies collapse. While humanitarian assistance may alleviate human distress in

the short term, rapid and substantial funding is needed for recover and reconstruction to

start and to mitigate the negative impacts which will be felt over months and years to come.
